title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
description:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.
  • Fluent German and English.


Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing.

Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA.

Why you should work at Famedly:

  • Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector.
  • Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments.
  • Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape.
  • Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths.
  • Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens.
  • Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space!
  • Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year.
  • Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club.
  • A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome.
  • Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit.


We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!

Instead of a cover letter, send us a link to something you've built (Rust preferred) and two or three sentences about how you work with coding agents.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: HR Leitung mit Fokus Recruiting (m/w/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Dabei steht und fällt unser Wachstum mit einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen ins Team – und erkennen wir früh genug, wenn nicht?

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und baust die People-Funktion eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit auf
  • Du gibst das System vor, andere setzen es um: Dein Recruiting-Team führt aus, unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen
  • Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Wenn eine Abteilung nicht läuft, sitzt du mit am Tisch und sagst, welche Rolle und welcher Mensch fehlt
  • Echte Perspektive: Du besetzt zunehmend Führungskräfte und Schlüsselpositionen in allen Abteilungen und prägst langfristig, wie wir Führungskräfte entwickeln
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung und führst das bestehende Team. Du gibst das System vor, also Funnel, Prozesse, SOPs und Kanäle, und entscheidest, wo und wie wir suchen. Für jede Rolle baust du ein Auswahlsystem aus Anforderungsprofilen, Scorecards, strukturierten Interviews, Arbeitsproben, Probetagen, digitalen Assessments und Referenzchecks.

Du besetzt unsere Key-Rollen in Sales und Account Management in hohem Volumen. Dazu kommen zunehmend Führungskräfte, Schlüsselpositionen und Rollen, die es so vorher nicht gab. Diese gewinnst du auch über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur: Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs und Landingpages.

Du kalibrierst alle, die bei uns Interviews führen. Du machst Fehlurteile sichtbar und bringst Gespür und Evidenz zusammen. Die Recruiting-Gespräche deines Teams reviewst du selbst und schlägst Alarm, sobald die Kandidatenqualität sinkt. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst verknüpfst du Probezeit und 90-Tage-Performance mit den Auswahldaten. Scheitern Probezeiten oder bleiben Hires hinter den Erwartungen, passt du die Kriterien an. Du sorgst außerdem dafür, dass Bewerber gut über uns sprechen, auch nach einer Absage. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht daran, wie viele Menschen du einstellst, sondern daran, wie gut sie sind:

  • Probezeit-Bestehensquote und 90-Tage-Performance deiner Hires
  • Trefferquote deiner Auswahlbewertungen
  • Time-to-Hire und Conversion im Funnel
  • Erfolgreich besetzte Führungs- und Schlüsselrollen
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen stehen ein dokumentierter Auswahlstandard für unsere Key-Rollen und ein Dashboard zur Qualität der Einstellungen, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut. Und die ersten Key-Hires sind an Bord.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung im internen Recruiting oder in HR mit klarem Recruiting-Schwerpunkt, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, performance-orientierten Unternehmen
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht
  • Echtes Gespür für Menschen: Du erkennst den Unterschied zwischen jemandem, der sich gut verkauft, und jemandem, der wirklich liefert
  • Dein Gespür sicherst du mit Struktur ab: Du weißt, welches Werkzeug wann hilft, und kannst jede Entscheidung begründen
  • Sales-Verständnis: Du hast Vertriebsrollen erfolgreich besetzt und kannst präzise erklären, was einen Top-Closer von einem guten Selbstdarsteller unterscheidet
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Besetzung von Teamleads, Heads of und Stabsstellen, auch bei Rollen, die es vorher nicht gab
  • Du baust Systeme, statt nur in ihnen zu arbeiten. Ineffizienzen fallen dir sofort auf, und die Lösung bringst du gleich mit
  • Du gewinnst auch A-Player, die gar nicht suchen, und hältst das Tempo eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens
  • Wenn ein Hire nicht funktioniert, spornt dich das an, statt dass du es erklärst
  • Du gibst der Geschäftsführung eindeutige Empfehlungen, auch wenn sie unbequem sind
  • Recruiting ist für dich Markenarbeit: Jeder Kandidat verlässt den Prozess mit einem guten Gefühl
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du hast schon eine HR-Abteilung inklusive Mitarbeiterbetreuung und Führungskräfteentwicklung geleitet
    • Du hast eigene Vertriebserfahrung
    • Du kennst High-Volume-Hiring
    • Du hast dich in Eignungsdiagnostik weitergebildet, z. B. mit einem Studium der Wirtschaftspsychologie
    • Du kennst Tools wie TestGorilla, Recruitee oder Close

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • HR für dich vor allem Verwaltung ist: Verträge, Payroll, Feel-Good. Unser Fokus ist Recruiting
  • du aus der Personalvermittlung kommst und dort vor allem Lebensläufe gesichtet und weitergereicht hast
  • du dich auf dein Bauchgefühl verlässt, ohne es je an Ergebnissen zu überprüfen
  • du als Gatekeeper Prozesse verlangsamst und dich hinter Methodik und Tests versteckst
  • du Modelle und Tests kennst, aber nie selbst eine Abteilung verantwortet hast
  • du lange Freigabeschleifen und große Budgets brauchst, um zu liefern
  • du Bewerber wie Bittsteller behandelst oder dich wichtiger nimmst als die Menschen, die du auswählst
  • du Probleme siehst, aber nicht klar ansprichst
  • Remote für dich Freiheit von Verbindlichkeit bedeutet
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht wachsen willst

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.

description:
Ein Abschluss ist bei uns kein Ziel, sondern ein Startpunkt.

Ab da sorgst du dafür, dass aus einem Vertrag ein zufriedener Kunde wird.

Unser Vertrieb gewinnt die Unternehmen, unser Marketing sorgt dafür, dass ihre Stellen bei den richtigen Jugendlichen ankommen. Du sitzt genau dazwischen. Aufgaben

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach dem Abschluss und begleitest sie durch das Onboarding. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen bringst du ihre Stellenanzeigen auf der Plattform so in Form, dass sie bei Jugendlichen wirklich ankommen.

Danach wird es analytisch. Du wertest aus, wie die Kampagnen und Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden laufen: Wie oft werden die Stellen gesehen, wie viele Klicks und Bewerbungen kommen rein, wo hakt es? Liegt ein Kunde hinter seinen Zielen, erkennst du das früh und stimmst mit dem Marketing ab, welche Maßnahme jetzt greift, etwa eine regionale Anzeigenkampagne oder eine überarbeitete Stellenanzeige.

Aus diesen Zahlen machst du Kommunikation. Du erstellst regelmäßige Reports für unsere Kunden, schreibst Newsletter und hältst den Kontakt so, dass Unternehmen jederzeit wissen, was mit ihren Stellen passiert und was wir als Nächstes tun.

Dabei denkst du das Schuljahr mit. Jugendliche suchen nicht das ganze Jahr gleich, rund um Praktikumsphasen, Halbjahresinformation oder Zeugnisse verändert sich die Nachfrage. Diesen Rhythmus nutzt du, um die richtigen Maßnahmen zur richtigen Zeit anzustoßen.

Und du bist der Kanal zurück ins Team. Du behältst die Vertragslaufzeiten im Blick, damit Kunden zur Verlängerung zufrieden sind und nicht erst dann gefragt werden. Will ein Unternehmen mehr Stellen besetzen, gibt du das an den Vertrieb weiter. Fehlt Kunden etwas im Produkt, landet das bei unserem Produktteam. Weil wir Customer Success gerade so aufbauen, dass er auch mit Hunderten Kunden funktioniert, gestaltest du Abläufe, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen aktiv mit.

Kein reiner Support, der Anfragen abarbeitet. Du verstehst, misst und kommunizierst, in dieser Reihenfolge.

Qualifikation

Wen wir uns vorstellen

Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und hast rund 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit. Ob du BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Psychologie oder etwas ganz anderes studierst, ist zweitrangig. Erste Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Marketing oder Projektarbeit ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Wichtiger ist uns: Du hast keine Scheu vor Zahlen und arbeitest gern mit Google Sheets oder Excel. Du kannst aus einer Auswertung eine klare Aussage machen und sie so aufschreiben, dass Personalverantwortliche im Mittelstand sie in zwei Minuten verstehen. Du bist gern im Austausch mit Menschen, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen Kunden gleichzeitig den Überblick.

Fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englisch von Vorteil.

Benefits

Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach deinem Stundenplan richten, und hybrides Arbeiten zwischen Office und Homeoffice.

Firmenlaptop und modernes CRM.

Arbeitsplatz am Campus Founders in Heilbronn, direkt auf dem Bildungscampus. Mensa, kostenloser Kaffee, Softdrinks, regelmäßige Teamevents und Veranstaltungen der Campus Community.

Customer Success entsteht bei uns gerade. Es gibt einen klaren Rahmen mit definierten Abläufen und Maßnahmen, aber vieles davon gestaltest du mit.   • A knack for storytelling — ability to understand customer needs and build compelling value propositions

  • Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly.

  • Autonomous, collaborative and an excellent communicator

About the Team:

TRM's EMEA Sales Team has a fast paced, positive and open culture. Team members are given a high degree of responsibility and autonomy. The team gets together for calls regularly. Your manager tries to be available to assist you with questions, problems or at customer meetings.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.

Working closely with our European teams, regional sales colleagues and technical experts, you will help shape our market position, strengthen customer relationships and unlock new opportunities in the growing mass timber sector.

  • Drive business growth: Execute our mass timber sales strategy and deliver revenue growth by developing new accounts, building a strong project pipeline and converting opportunities into business.

  • Be a trusted customer partner: Advise customers on product specifications, certifications and compliance requirements, working closely with our technical experts.

  • Shape our business development strategy: Identify market needs and gaps in our product and service portfolio and translate customer feedback into actionable business opportunities.

  • Work across borders: Collaborate with regional sales teams and European colleagues to develop opportunities and support international mass timber projects.

  • Own your business performance: Manage your sales pipeline, forecasts and KPIs, maintain customer and opportunity data in Salesforce and regularly report on business performance and growth opportunities.

Your primary sales responsibility will cover Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH). At the same time, you will contribute to the development of our mass timber business across the European regions defined in our strategy, supporting international projects where relevant stakeholders are based in DACH.

In short: You combine technical understanding, commercial thinking and a passion for developing new markets.

What you bring to the table

You don't need to tick every single box.

What matters most is your ability to understand the construction industry, build strong relationships and turn market potential into measurable business results.

Ideally, you bring:

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in sales, business development or a comparable commercial role, preferably in construction, timber or sustainable building materials.

  • A strong understanding of the construction value chain and the ability to engage with architects, engineers, developers, contractors and other industry stakeholders.

  • An analytical mindset with the ability to assess market potential, identify business opportunities and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working in an international or pan-European business environment, with an understanding of different regional market dynamics.

  • A degree or equivalent qualification in architecture, engineering or construction – this technical background is essential for the role.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in German and English, combined with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at different levels.

  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating across functions and countries.

  • A willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80%).

Experience in mass timber, engineered wood products (EWP), timber engineering or prefabricated construction would be a strong advantage.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is curious, commercially driven and motivated to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

What you can expect at Simpson Strong-Tie

We are an international company with a clear mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

But we believe that great results come from more than great products. They come from people who take ownership, share ideas and make things happen.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, you can expect:

Real impact and ownership

You will have the opportunity to shape a growing business area and directly influence our position in the European mass timber market.

A strong international network

You will work with experienced colleagues across Europe, combining local market knowledge with international expertise.

Innovative solutions with purpose

You will be part of an industry that is transforming the way we build – with solutions that contribute to safer, stronger and more sustainable structures.

Room to grow

We encourage initiative, personal development and new ideas. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility and make a real difference.

Ready to shape the future of construction?

If you are passionate about sustainable construction, enjoy developing business opportunities and want to make an impact in a growing market, we would love to hear from you.

Your career path doesn't have to match every point on this list. If you bring the right mindset, experience and motivation, we encourage you to apply.

title: Location Data engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

title: Research Engineer
description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role:

You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will".

Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

Preferred:

Perks

title: Defense Success Manager, France
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices.
