Als Revenue Operations Intern (w/m/d) bei LIQID wirst du:

Reports und Dashboards in HubSpot und Omni für Sales, Relationship Management und das Leadership-Team aufbauen und laufend weiterentwickeln. Du bist erste Anlaufstelle für Fragen und Anliegen von HubSpot-Nutzer:innen, dokumentierst Lösungen und Konfigurationen und hilfst dabei, das System verständlich und effizient zu nutzen.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst du Aufgaben im Bereich Datenqualität: Du identifizierst und behebst Duplikate, leerstehende oder ungenutzte Properties sowie fehlerhafte Ansichten direkt an der Ursache. Du unterstützt den oder die RevOps Manager:in bei der HubSpot-Administration – etwa bei Nutzer:innen, Teams und Properties – sowie bei der Bereinigung nach der Salesforce-Migration.

Zudem arbeitest du mit den kommerziellen Teams an kleinen Projekten: Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, entwickelst daraus Lösungen und begleitest sie bis zur Umsetzung, einschließlich einfacher Automatisierungen, die vor dem Go-live geprüft werden.

Die Position ist ab Januar 2027 zu besetzen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Teamübergreifende Einblicke: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Relationship Management und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und lernst, wie Revenue Operations die operativen Abläufe eines wachsenden Fintechs unterstützt.

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungen: Du erstellst und pflegst Reports und Dashboards in HubSpot und Omni und hilfst unseren Teams, fundierte Entscheidungen auf Basis verlässlicher Daten zu treffen.

  • Operative Unterstützung: Du unterstützt unsere Teams bei Fragen rund um HubSpot, dokumentierst Lösungen und hilfst dabei, Hindernisse im Arbeitsalltag zu beseitigen.

  • Eigene Projekte: Du begleitest kleinere Projekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Umsetzung – von Prozessverbesserungen bis hin zu einfachen Automatisierungen, die vor dem Go-live gemeinsam geprüft werden.

  • Datenqualität und CRM: Du verbesserst die Qualität unserer CRM-Daten und unterstützt bei der HubSpot-Administration sowie bei der Bereinigung nach der Salesforce-Migration.

  • Praxisnahes Lernen: Du erlebst hautnah, wie aus Daten, Prozessen und technischen Lösungen konkrete Verbesserungen entstehen – in einem Unternehmen, das über 4 Milliarden Euro an Vermögen verwaltet.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast dein Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Fach vor Kurzem abgeschlossen.

  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt – etwa durch ein Praktikum, eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit, eine studentische Initiative oder ein Ehrenamt. Idealerweise hattest du dabei Berührungspunkte mit Vertrieb, Finanzen oder Datenanalyse.

  • Du gehst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets um und hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce gesammelt.

  • Du denkst strukturiert und analytisch und priorisierst Aufgaben danach, welchen Mehrwert sie für das Unternehmen schaffen.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verständlich – schriftlich wie mündlich und auch mit Kolleg:innen ohne technischen Hintergrund.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben, bringst sie eigenständig zum Abschluss und dokumentierst deine Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.

  • Du bist neugierig, möchtest dazulernen und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau, idealerweise C1, sowie Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.

Damit punktest du zusätzlich

  • Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie erste Erfahrungen mit einem Business-Intelligence-Tool wie Omni, Looker, Power BI oder Tableau.

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit der Erstellung automatisierter Workflows, beispielsweise mit n8n, Zapier oder Make.

  • Erfahrung mit der Einführung von KI-Tools in einem Unternehmen oder einer Organisation.

  • Interesse an Finanzthemen oder Vermögensverwaltung.

  • Zertifizierungen der HubSpot Academy.

Erfüllst du nicht alle Bedingungen ? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Diversität: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich vom ersten Tag an zu einem integralen Teil unseres vielfältigen Teams internationaler Talente.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht komplizierter, sondern einfacher. Mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten findest du die Balance, die zu dir passt. 24 Urlaubstage sowie zwei zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31. Dezember sorgen für ausreichend Erholung.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements – in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen mit hoher Markt­relevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Ausstattung: MacBook, Kopfhörer und Bildschirm gehören bei uns selbstverständlich dazu.

  • Well-being: Mittagessen budget von bis zu 112,50 € im Monat sowie regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich in unserem Büro am Ku’damm fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen wie Beachvolleyball, die Soccer Startup League oder unser Health Assistance Program sorgen darüber hinaus für dein Wohlbefinden.

So geht es für dich weiter

title: Senior Indirect Tax Manager (all genders)
description:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Senior Indirect Tax Manager (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

As Senior Indirect Tax Manager in our Global Tax function, you are the go-to person for European VAT and a trusted sparring partner for our growing international business. You give pragmatic, business-minded advice on VAT, sales tax and GST across our markets. You also build the structures and processes behind it: VAT set-ups in SAP Public Cloud, well-documented indirect tax processes and smart automation using modern tools, including AI.

What you'll do

  • Lead & Advise: Drive our European VAT agenda, manage global sales tax/GST, and advise internal teams on cross-border trade, e-commerce, and marketplace taxation.

  • System & Process: Build and maintain VAT logic in SAP Public Cloud, translating complex tax requirements into actionable guidelines for daily accounting operations.

  • Risk & Compliance: Document tax processes to audit-ready standards, conduct local risk assessments (e.g., VAT, plastic taxes), and implement consistent tax frameworks across projects.

  • Business Partnering: Collaborate with Finance, Operations, E-commerce, and Supply Chain to embed VAT compliance across the value chain and proactively address commercial shifts.

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track global regulatory changes (e.g., digital reporting, ViDA, platform rules) and ensure timely organizational compliance.

  • Filing & Reporting: Oversee and be capable of preparing the accurate and timely preparation, review, and filing of VAT returns, EC sales lists, Intrastat, and other statutory filings.

  • Digital Transformation: Drive the automation of tax workflows using Alteryx for data analytics and AI tools (Gemini, Claude) to boost efficiency and consistency.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Challenge advice from external tax consultants and translate their findings into plain English for non-tax colleagues.

  • Project Management: Own end-to-end tax projects—from scoping to execution—while independently aligning internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strategic Impact: Report to the Global Tax Lead, ensuring tax considerations are fully integrated into broader business strategies and decision-making.

What You Bring

  • Degree in Business, Tax, Law, or a related field with a strong focus on taxation.

  • Multiple years of in-house indirect tax experience within an international corporate environment.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in European VAT, including cross-border supplies, OSS/IOSS, import VAT, and e-commerce.

  • Proven ability to break down complex VAT regulations into clear, practical instructions for non-tax teams.

  • Solid experience configuring or working with tax logic in an ERP system.

  • Hands-on experience with (or a strong eagerness to leverage) AI tools and data analytics (e.g., Alteryx).

  • Highly analytical, structured, and result-driven, with a pragmatic approach to supporting a fast-growing business.

  • Proactive, adaptable, and interculturally aware, backed by excellent communication skills.

  • Business fluency in both written and spoken English and German.

  • Commitment to regular on-site collaboration at our Düsseldorf office.

Nice to have:

  • Background in a tax advisory firm.

  • Knowledge of non-EU sales tax/GST frameworks (e.g., UK, US, Canada, Australia).

  • Hands-on experience with SAP Public Cloud.

Why Join Us?

  • Global teamwork: We work together across departmental and national borders on our vision of bringing the Toniebox to every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code, but to everything else as well. Because you can only give your best when you feel truly comfortable.

  • Mobility: Choose the offer that best suits you – a Germany ticket for unlimited mobility, a monthly payment of fifty euros for an office parking space, a leased bicycle or a remote work allowance.

  • Protection: Benefit from subsidies for employee savings plans, company pension schemes and disability insurance.

  • Relaxation & Time Out: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off, such as Carnival Monday, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also take up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave).

  • Continuous professional development: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language learning and relaxation made easy: Improve your communication skills with the Babbel language learning app and find relaxation through our access to the Calm meditation app.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire tonies range.

 

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Head of Growth // AI Music Video Platform
description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Our next target is a $15M run rate.

We grew around 3x in the last year with a small team and a founder who ran most of growth himself. We now have specialists across content, creators, design, paid, SEO and growth engineering, and we need the person who leads them: someone who owns the numbers, sets the direction and still does the work.

As our Head of Growth, you'll work directly beside the founder. You'll own new top of funnel traffic, paying customers, and acquisition cost, decide where the team spends its time, approve what goes out, and personally work on whatever is the biggest bottleneck. You'll also build the rest of the marketing team.

Tasks

  • Own our growth numbers: top of funnel traffic, new paying customers, acquisition cost by channel

  • Set quarterly goals, run the weekly growth meeting, and make sure every person on the team owns one number

  • Work hands-on on the biggest bottleneck, from landing page tests and onboarding emails to paid campaigns and creator deals

  • Approve paid creatives and content, and raise the creative and messaging bar across the team

  • Come up with the big messaging ideas, test them across landing pages, ads, social and email, and keep what wins

  • Build AI workflows and automations that make the whole team faster

  • Lead and grow the marketing team, including hiring the next roles

  • Plan and run campaigns such as product launches and seasonal offers together with product

Requirements

  • You have owned growth numbers at a B2C or self-serve product, ideally a consumer subscription or creator tool, and can show what you changed in paying customers, conversion or acquisition cost

  • You are hands-on. You still build campaigns, tests and ads yourself, and you're happy doing it

  • You have deep expertise in at least one of SEO/GEO, performance marketing or social media growth, and a good working knowledge of the others

  • You have a strong eye for creative and messaging, and you know how to improve an ad based on its numbers

  • AI is fully part of how you work. You build your own automations, agents and bots, and can show us some

  • You are analytical and comfortable in tools like PostHog, SQL and ad managers

  • You have built something on your own, whether a company, a side project, music or a sport, and you bring that drive to work

  • You communicate clearly, challenge directly and take ownership without waiting for instructions

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You have led people before, and you make the people around you better

  • Experience with music, video, creator tools or AI products

  • You have built a growth function from scratch at a small company

  • You make music or video yourself

How we measure success

Within your first month, you understand our product, users and channels, own a weekly growth scorecard with clear baselines, and we have agreed on targets for the quarter. You're already running the first experiments on the biggest bottleneck.

Within 90 days, you run growth and content without the founder in the loop, messaging tests run every month with clear winners, the numbers are moving, and you're hiring the next person on the team.

Within a year, marketing runs as a team with clear owners and goals, new paying customers are growing steadily against our targets, and growth no longer depends on the founder.

Benefits

VSOPs and profit sharing, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning and development support, productivity tools, a headphone allowance, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

Neural Frames is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and are committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace.

title: Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and operation of the Flight Control System (FCS) test environment (“Iron Bird”) at VÆRIDION.

You will lead a major engineering project with significant cost and program impact, ensuring the successful development of a fully integrated test rig that enables system integration, validation, and certification of the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control system.

You will work at the interface of mechanical systems, actuation, control, and system integration, contributing directly to the development and certification of electric aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Test Strategy & System Responsibility

    • Take ownership of the test concept and strategy for the Flight Control System (FCS).

    • Define test requirements, architectures, and validation approaches for system-level testing.

    • Ensure alignment of all test activities with development, safety of flight, and certification objectives.

  • Iron Bird Development (Test Rig Project Leadership)

    • Lead the development, implementation, and commissioning of the FCS Iron Bird test rig.

    • Define system architecture, interfaces, and functional requirements of the test environment.

    • Manage the development of mechanical, electrical, and control system integration within the test rig.

    • Drive supplier selection, coordination, and technical oversight for test rig development (CAPEX project).

    • Ensure delivery of the test rig within program timelines, budget, and technical requirements.

  • Test Execution & System Validation

    • Plan and execute system-level test campaigns on the Iron Bird.

    • Ensure reliable, high-quality test data generation and reporting.

    • Analyse system behaviour and support validation of flight control performance and safety.

    • Support verification and certification activities.

  • Test Asset Ownership

    • Own the Iron Bird test asset, ensuring configuration control, readiness, and safe operation.

    • Establish processes for operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the test rig.

    • Ensure traceability and reproducibility of test configurations and results.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with flight controls, systems engineering, structures, and test teams.

    • Interface with design engineers to ensure testability and integration readiness.

    • Support integration of hardware, actuators, sensors, and control systems.

  • Health, Safety & Compliance

    • Promote and uphold a strong safety culture in all test activities.

    • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, especially for complex mechanical systems.

    • Establish risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and training for test operations.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field.

  • Extensive experience in testing and validation of complex mechanical or aerospace systems.

  • Proven experience in developing test rigs or large-scale test environments.

  • Experience in leading technical projects with high complexity and impact.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, actuation, and mechanical flight control architectures.

  • Experience in system integration testing, ideally in aerospace applications.

  • Experience with development of test rigs, Iron Birds, or similar system-level test environments.

  • Knowledge of instrumentation, measurement systems, and data acquisition.

  • Understanding of certification-driven testing and validation processes.

  • Experience managing suppliers and external partners for engineering projects.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive complex projects to completion.

  • Excellent problem-solving and system-level thinking skills.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus.

Why us?

description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The Role

Encord handles sensitive, high-value data for our customers, including in regulated industries like healthcare. In an era where exploits and supply-chain attacks are being discovered and executed faster than ever, it's vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers' data safe.

Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale into more industries with their diverse security and regulatory requirements, we want someone who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification.

What We're Looking For

We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff). For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We're looking for that "T"-shaped skillset where the candidate's depth is in Cloud Security.

The ideal candidate will have a product, infrastructure or network engineering background but caught the bug for security, and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we're looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier, someone who answers questions with a "Here's how we do it securely."

What Can You Expect?

  • A strong team. You'll join a team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work.

  • Modern, cloud-native stack. Cloud-native and IaC-driven: GCP and Terraform, with TypeScript/Python across the stack.

  • Scalability challenges. As we scale, you'll help evolve our infrastructure to defend against new threats and keep us one step ahead.

  • Customer impact. Delivering on our compliance goals and successfully handling audits.

  • Massive ownership. You own problems end-to-end, from brainstorming through to production, and you thrive in ambiguity.

  • Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

About You

  • Cloud security specialist. Deep knowledge of GCP: IAM, VPC and networking, firewall and perimeter controls, KMS, secrets management, logging/monitoring, and org-level policy. You understand cloud-native architectures and their trade-offs.

  • Network security depth. You understand network segmentation, private connectivity, zero-trust patterns, TLS/mTLS, and how to secure traffic between services and to the outside world.

  • Platform engineer & builder. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code. You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and security gates at scale.

  • Security as an enabler. You treat engineers and the business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure and security exist to serve the product and the business, and you make trade-offs with that in mind.

  • Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience securing other cloud providers (AWS, Azure) or on-premise / hybrid environments, so we can meet our customers wherever they run.

  • ISC2 (any level) or relevant cloud security certification (e.g. GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).

  • Experience with SaaS compliance programs (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA).

  • Open-source contributions to security, infrastructure, or developer-tooling projects.

  • Daily company lunches

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

What you bring

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)

The opportunity

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

What you will build and lead

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

  • access to care, search and booking;

  • patient messaging and teleconsultation;

  • the Patient Health Record and patient context;

  • the app homepage and daily health experience;

  • health content and prevention;

  • recommendations, reminders and care plans;

  • new patient services and subscription experiences;

  • conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

Your mandate

You will:

  • Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.

  • Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.

  • Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.

  • Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.

  • Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.

  • Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.

  • Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.

  • Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.

  • Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.

  • Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will have:

  • established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;

  • raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;

  • helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;

  • strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;

  • developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;

  • helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

What we are looking for

You are likely to bring:

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design.

  • Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

  • Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

  • Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

  • Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a System Performance Intern in Toulouse.


About the role:

We are seeking a motivated System Performance Intern to join our System Performance team in Toulouse. During this six-month internship, you will support system-level design, modelling and performance analysis activities for Kronos full-flow staged-combustion rocket engines.

You will work closely with System Performance engineers and specialists in combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to connect engine requirements and design choices with cycle modelling, subsystem characteristics and overall engine performance. You will be involved in the development and execution of engine models, investigating nominal, throttled and off-nominal operating conditions, and assessing how evolving subsystem designs influence the complete propulsion system. The work will include sensitivity studies, design trade-offs and support to the definition of operating and control strategies.

This internship requires strong fundamentals in thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, an understanding of liquid rocket-engine cycles, and the ability to interpret numerical results critically rather than treating simulation tools as black boxes. You will contribute to transient analyses covering start-up, throttling and shutdown, and consolidate results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes, subsystem requirements and technical documentation for design reviews.

Key Responsibilities:

· Develop, modify and execute system-level engine models in EcosimPro/ESPSS.

· Analyse nominal operating points and engine operational envelopes, including throttled and off-nominal conditions.

· Support engine-cycle optimisation and system-level design trade-offs.

· Perform sensitivity studies on key design and operational parameters.

· Translate simulation results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes and subsystem requirements.

· Support preparation and maintenance of System Performance documentation for project design reviews.

· Work with combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to integrate evolving subsystem designs into the system model.

What you need to be successful:

· MSc in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent, preferably with a background in propulsion, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, energy systems or numerical modelling.

· Experience with numerical modelling and engineering analysis through academic or professional projects.

· Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

· Understanding of liquid rocket propulsion and the fundamental operation of rocket-engine cycles.

· Ability to analyse coupled engineering systems and critically interpret simulation results.

· Basic programming or engineering scripting capability, preferably Python and/or MATLAB.

Soft Skills:

· Strong analytical problem-solving skills.

· Ability to communicate technical results clearly in English through documentation and presentations.

· You are expected to work in a structured and analytical manner, communicate your results clearly, and progressively take ownership of defined modelling and analysis tasks while receiving guidance from experienced engineers.

Other useful skills:

· Experience with EcosimPro/ESPSS or another 0D/1D system-simulation environment.

· Knowledge of staged-combustion or full-flow staged-combustion rocket-engine cycles.

· Understanding of turbopumps, turbines, pre-burners, combustion chambers, regenerative cooling circuits, valves and feed systems.

· Experience with transient simulation, controls or system dynamics.

· Experience with sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation or Monte Carlo methods.

· Experience processing engineering data using Python or MATLAB.

· Familiarity with Git/version control and structured engineering-development processes.

· A university project, thesis or previous internship involving propulsion-system modelling.

We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach der Unterschrift und bringst sie in den ersten 90 Tagen in die produktive Nutzung. Du leitest den Kick-off, klärst mit dem Kunden, wer ausschreibt und mit welchem Projekt es losgeht, schulst Einkauf, Kalkulation und Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Ausschreibungen rausgehen und Angebote zurückkommen. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, merkst du es früh und drehst ihn, notfalls über die Geschäftsführung. Nach 90 Tagen übergibst du ihn mit klarem Stand an seinen Account Manager.

Du begleitest viele Kunden parallel, vom Familienbetrieb bis zum Generalunternehmer mit mehreren Niederlassungen. Als Senior Implementation Consultant übernimmst du die komplexen Einführungen: mehrere Standorte oder Gesellschaften, Freigabeprozesse, Systemlandschaften und viele Beteiligte. Und du entwickelst mit, wie unser Consulting-Team arbeitet.

Du berichtest an die Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Deine Kunden sind nach 90 Tagen produktiv: Sie schreiben über Cosuno aus und erhalten Angebote, nachweisbar im Activation Report.

  • Jeder Kick-off endet mit klaren Zusagen: ausschreibende Nutzer, erstes Projekt, Termine, Mandat der Geschäftsführung.

  • Kunden, die hinter Plan liegen, haben schnell einen Plan, und die meisten holen auf.

  • Deine Kunden bewerten ihr Onboarding gut, und dein Account Manager weiß bei der Übergabe genau, wo der Kunde steht.

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, rufst du an, statt auf die nächste Mail zu warten.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und es dich reizt, gerade die Skeptiker zu überzeugen.

  • du lieber vom Ziel rückwärts planst, als Schulungen abzuarbeiten.

  • du bei vielen Kunden parallel den Überblick behältst und weißt, wer heute deine Zeit bekommt.

  • du mit Kalkulatoren und Geschäftsführern gleichermaßen auf Augenhöhe sprichst.

  • du verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft und vergeben wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als eine Reihe von Produktdemos verstehst.

  • du lieber in langen Projekten mit wenigen Kunden berätst als viele Kunden schnell zum Ergebnis zu bringen.

  • du wartest, bis der Kunde sich meldet.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

 

What You'll Do

  • Multichannel Outreach: Execute targeted outreach campaigns using phone, email, and LinkedIn/social touches to engage target prospects.

  • Lead Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with key decision-makers—such as CFOs, Travel Managers, and Office Managers—to assess fit and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  • Value Articulation: Clearly communicate Perk’s value proposition and build immediate credibility with prospective clients.

  • CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate prospect data and activity tracking within Salesforce.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing to refine target accounts, test new messaging, and optimize the lead-qualification process.

  • Sales Acumen: Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales processes or outbound prospect outreach.

  • Process & Execution: High organizational skills, comfort working with CRMs (Salesforce preferred), and a focus on hitting output metrics.

 

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistent Pipeline Generation: You hit and exceed your monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and opportunities created.

  • High Outreach Discipline: You maintain steady, structured daily outreach activity (calls, emails, social touches) using Salesforce and modern sales tools.

  • Value-Driven Discovery: You master Perk’s value proposition early, allowing you to ask smart discovery questions and handle client objections with confidence.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: You collaborate seamlessly with Account Executives to ensure smooth handover of leads and high show-up rates for meetings.

  • Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

 

Interview Process

  2. Role Assessment: 60-minute in-person interview & practical exercise.

  3. Values & Culture Fit: 30-minute virtual interview.

 

What We Offer

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Want to Learn More Before You Apply?

Join our DACH team for The SDR Diaries: DACH Edition to hear directly from our current SDRs about life at Perk! We’ll cover day-to-day responsibilities, live objection handling, real experiences relocating to Barcelona, and tips for navigating our interview process.

 

🔗 Register for the event here: https://luma.com/kztwu46o

How We Set You Up to Succeed (Work Schedule)

  • First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

  • Post-Probation Schedule: Standard hybrid model, 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Head of Direct Mail
description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Lead Acquisition B2C
description:
Green-Got en bref

Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement.

En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction.

  • Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide.

  • Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites.

  • Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi.

Quelques repères :

  • Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres

  • 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion

  • 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record

Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests.

  • Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

  • Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier.

  • Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut.

  • Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique.

  • Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement.

  • Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

L'équipe autour de toi

Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires :

  1. Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre

  2. Acquisition haut de funnel : toi

  3. CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes

Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management.

Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider.
Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise.

Ton profil

Indispensable

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en acquisition, growth ou traffic management (tes side projects comptent)

  • Tu es un faiseur : tu livres, tu shippes, tu passes vite d'un sujet à l'autre

  • Tu es data driven. Tu as de l'instinct, mais tu valides tout avec la data.

  • Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien et tu as déjà construit des outils ou des automatisations avec.

  • Tu es autonome, débrouillard et problem solver : face à un problème, tu trouves une solution

  • Tu as un mindset business : tu raisonnes en chiffre d'affaires, pas en vanity metrics

  • Tu t'intéresses vraiment à la finance.

  • Tu es sensible aux enjeux d'écologie, de transition à l'échelle française et européenne, et de santé

  • Tu es créatif, proactif, organisé et rigoureux

  • Tu parles anglais

Ce qui nous fera vraiment craquer

  • Tu as déjà lancé tes propres projets : une boutique e-commerce, un site d'affiliation, des side projects. Tu as tenté des choses.

  • Tu viens d'agence, mais tu as des projets à côté et tu veux maintenant aller plus loin : un seul annonceur, beaucoup de budget, de vrais résultats à porter.

  • Tu as déjà travaillé dans la finance ou la fintech, et tu connais les règles de la communication sur les produits financiers.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour toi si…

  • Tu préfères concevoir la stratégie et laisser d'autres l'exécuter

  • Tu présentes tes résultats en clics, en impressions ou en leads sans te soucier du resultat final

title: Lead Solution Architect – D365 F&O Finance & SCM (f/m/x)
description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you'll do

Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in the Finance (R2R, O2C, MDG) squad and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale.

As A Lead Solution Architect, you own the Finance & SCM architecture across D365 F&O, defining how GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, and Project Accounting are structured, governed, and evolved across 30+ legal entities. You set the design standards that functional consultants, developers, and partners work within, lead the decisions that are hard to reverse, and ensure that the Finance platform is the trusted, auditable system of record that a complex, multi-entity enterprise demands. In the agentic enterprise, you are also the architectural authority for the Finance agent layer, ensuring that Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate on a platform that is deterministic, traceable, and financially compliant.

FINANCE ARCHITECTURE & AGENTIC FOUNDATION

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Finance architecture across modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, and Cost Accounting

  • Design the architectural foundation for Finance AI agents, ensuring the D365 core provides the deterministic ledger, traceable decisions, and full audit trail that agentic operations require

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements (IFRS/local GAAP), and global design principles across all legal entities

  • Translate complex Finance business requirements into robust D365 F&O designs, clean-core first, with customizations only where legally required or business-critical

STANDARDIZATION & GLOBAL ROLLOUT

  • Drive standardization, harmonization, and process simplification across regions and legal entities, ensuring the pilot BU design is locked and rolled out consistently

  • Ensure all Finance solutions are designed in a reliable, robust, and scalable way, ready for rollout across 30+ legal entities in the M9–M15 timeframe

  • Lead solution governance, blueprinting, and architectural decision-making across the Finance domain

  • Provide thought leadership on best practices, industry trends, and Microsoft ecosystem capabilities, including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Fabric

DELIVERY LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

  • Provide hands-on guidance to functional consultants, developers, and integration teams, ensuring high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare

  • Ensure high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and support phases

  • Represent Finance architecture in ERP governance forums, design authority reviews, and steering committees up to CFO level

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in ERP Finance & SCM transformation, with significant hands-on experience in D365 F&O Finance across multiple modules and global rollouts

  • Proven architectural leadership designing end-to-end Finance solutions, including integrations, data models, extensions, and ISV evaluations, ideally within high-growth or complex organizations

  • Deep functional expertise in core Finance processes (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, Cost Accounting) and strong understanding of IFRS/local GAAP

  • Strong fluency in D365 F&O architecture, including data entities and integration patterns

  • Understanding of or strong interest in agentic AI in Finance: how Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate, and what the platform must provide to support them

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, including Finance Directors and CFO, with clear communication and decision-making
